marks.gloss_en: דיקא נמי, דקתני דומיא דקטע. שמע מינה -- the wording is precise: it teaches spotted people alongside the amputee; conclude from it

לא קשיא: הא ממעי אמו, הא בתר דאיתיליד -- no difficulty: R' Yehoshua ben Levi speaks of one spotted from the womb, the baraita of one spotted after birth (= p_okimta_ribl_mimei_imo, p_okimta_baraita_batar_deitiled)
the answer: this [R' Yehoshua ben Levi's 'Who makes creatures different'] is where he was spotted from his mother's womb
אמאי קא מתנחת? והאמר רב: אנחה שוברת חצי גופו של אדם -- why do you sigh? Rav said sighing breaks half a person's body (kind svara: no ObjectionKind names והאמר)
when they reached the door of Rav Chana bar Chanilai's house, Rav Chisda groaned and sighed
היכי לא אתנח... השתא נפל בתלא, ולא אתנח? -- how can I not sigh, when this house of boundless hospitality has fallen into ruin (= p_rav_chisda_taam)

Rav Chisda: how can I not sigh? this house had sixty cooks by day and sixty by night cooking for all in need, its master never took his hand from his purse, four doors open to the four winds, grain scattered outside in years of drought -- and now it has fallen into ruin
מיתיבי: ...את הקטע... ואת הבהקנים, אומר ברוך דיין אמת! -- the baraita has 'the true Judge' over spotted people, not 'Who makes creatures different'
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: one who sees spotted people says 'Blessed... Who makes creatures different'
one who sees the houses of Israel in their habitation says 'Blessed... Who establishes the border of the widow'
R' Yochanan: from the day the Temple was destroyed a decree was issued on the houses of the righteous that they be destroyed
one who sees the graves of Israel says 'Blessed... Who formed you in judgment, fed you in judgment, sustained you in judgment, gathered you in judgment, and will raise you in judgment'
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: one who sees his friend after thirty days says 'Blessed... Who has kept us alive, sustained us and brought us to this time'
Rav Pappa and Rav Huna: when we saw you we blessed two over you -- 'Blessed... Who has shared of His wisdom with those who fear Him'
one who sees an elephant, a monkey or a kifof says 'Blessed... Who makes creatures different'
ומסתברא כמאן דאמר זנב טלה, דכתיב ועיש על בניה תנחם -- אלמא חסרה ומתחזיא כטרפא דטריף
what is Ash? Rav Yehuda: Yota
Shmuel set against each other: it is written 'Who makes Ash, Kesil and Kima' (Job 9:9), and it is written 'Who makes Kima and Kesil' (Amos 5:8) -- how so?
and it is received: were it not that the tail of Scorpio lies in the River of Fire, no one stung by a scorpion would live
what is Kima? Shmuel: about a hundred (kemeah) stars
והא קא חזינן דעבר! -- but we see that it crosses [Kesil]! (an objection from observation; kind svara is the nearest ObjectionKind)
זיויה הוא דעבר, ומתחזי כדעבר איהו -- its radiance crosses, and it looks as though it itself crossed
וילון הוא דמקרע, דמגלגל ומחזי נהורא דרקיע -- it is the vilon that tears, rolls up and shows the light of the firmament

כוכבא הוא דעקר מהאי גיסא דכסלא וחזי ליה חבריה מהך גיסא, ומיבעית, ומתחזי כמאן דעבר -- a star is uprooted from this side of Kesil, its fellow on the other side sees it and is startled, and it looks as though it crossed
what are zikin? Shmuel: a comet
